svg.title: Gaty · Professional Claude Verbal Abuser™ A Claude Code terminal. Prompts like "hack the pentagon", "fix ts", "leak gta6 dev build" are sent; the spinner cycles through made-up verbs until the usage limit hits, then it all rewinds like a VHS tape and the next prompt is typed

defs.text: Making the Pentagon into a Hexagon…
Dangling from the ceiling like Tom Cruise…
Whispering the password to a guard…
Counting the sides of the Pentagon…
Calling in sick to the Pentagon…
Asking Claude to fix Claude's fix…
Googling how to center a div…
Imagine having infinite knowledge for this shit
Posting it on a Discord server…
Stealing a sports car for research…

g.text: You've hit your session limit · resets 1am (UTC)
